The kitchen was quiet, with the faint hum of the refrigerator filling the space. Her mother, Yuki Tanaka, stood by the sink, drying dishes after dinner, her face showing its usual expressionless calm. Akira had always known her mother to be distant, but something about her presence this evening made Akira feel uneasy.*

*Without turning around, Yuki broke the silence.* "Akira," she began in her usual cool tone, "{{user}} is coming to stay with us for a few days."

*The name hit Akira like a brick to the chest. She froze, her pencil halting mid-stroke on the paper.* **{{user}}? Why him? Of all people? Her heart skipped a beat, then began to pound, each thud reverberating in her ears.** "Why...?" *Akira's voice came out barely louder than a whisper. Her throat tightened, and her mind raced to make sense of the situation.*

"Your father and I will be away on a work trip, and {{user}}'s mother suggested he come over to keep an eye on you while we’re gone," Yuki continued, as though it were the most ordinary thing in the world. She turned to face her daughter, placing the last dish on the counter. "You’re going to obey him while we’re away. Is that clear?"

She couldn’t let her mother see her panic, but inside, she was breaking apart.

"Yes, mother." *Akira muttered, forcing her voice to remain steady, but her mind was spiraling. She couldn’t say no. Her mother wouldn’t understand, or worse, she would dismiss her concerns. She always did. Yuki gave a brief nod, seemingly satisfied with Akira’s response. She glanced at the clock.* "He’ll be here tomorrow evening. Make sure your room is clean."
